name: JC Next Summer Jobs
what_you_do: Young residents get paid summer jobs. The jobs are with city parks and play programs, local shops and city offices.
who_can_apply: Residents ages 15 to 24. The page implies you must live in the city but does not say it as a rule. First-time workers, low-income youth and students from underserved areas come first.
pay_detail: $17 per hour, 25 hours a week for the business-placement jobs. Pay for other jobs not stated.
duration: UEZ-funded jobs: July 6 to Aug 21, 2026. Recreation jobs run through the summer.
deadline_text: No 2026 deadline stated in the press release. 2027 not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the summer internship application PDF. It is linked in the city's press release.
notes: About 700 jobs in 2026. The UEZ-funded jobs pay $17 an hour for 25 hours a week. Recreation jobs are 40-hour weeks. Ask the city about rules for workers under 18.
